3d_moments: Hero section: Use React Three Fiber (R3F) for floating abstract glowing tickets or geometric sound-waves reflecting the neon colors (#D3FF24, #FF2E93). Add mouse-tracking parallax.
Seat Map: Use a 3D isometric or tilted 2.5D view (via R3F or Spline). Interactive hover on seats zooms in and highlights the seat using post-processing (Bloom effect).
Event Details: Include subtle 3D tilt (Framer Motion) on the main event poster.

landing.hero: Full viewport height. Dark cinematic background image + heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60). Big Cabinet Grotesk typography. 3D abstract object floating. Primary neon CTA.
landing.featured_events: Bento grid layout. Glassmorphism cards. High contrast event dates in JetBrains Mono overlaying luxury imagery.
landing.categories: Asymmetric layout with overlapping images and text.

event_detail.layout: Split layout: Left side sticky with massive event title, date, and CTA. Right side scrollable with descriptions, performer details, and images.
event_detail.info_blocks: Grid of info boxes (Date, Venue, Price) using Neon Outline surface.
event_detail.cta_bar: Sticky bottom bar on mobile, inline on desktop. Strong neon glow effect.

seat_selection.layout: Control Room Grid. Left side (col-span-3): 3D or high-fidelity 2D Seat Map. Right side (col-span-1): Booking summary, tier legend, and checkout trigger.
seat_selection.seat_states: Available (grey outline), Selected (Neon Yellow fill + glow), Taken (Dark grey, disabled), VIP/Premium (Pink/Cyan outlines).

checkout.layout: Narrow centered column for high focus. Crystal Glass surface for the main form.
checkout.inputs: Floating labels, dark inputs with neon focus states.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation. Main area uses Grid Borders for a technical, premium ledger feel. Ticket list styled as perforated digital tickets with QR codes.

hero_concert.description: Energetic crowd night concert dramatic lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive elements must have semantic data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-now-btn').
Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for the 3D moments (hero floating elements, 3D seat representation).
Ensure high contrast: The text color on #D3FF24 (Electric Lime) must be Black (#000000).
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds. Use #050505.
Do not use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto. Use Cabinet Grotesk (headings), Outfit (body), JetBrains Mono (data/numbers).
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions on seat selection.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for marketing landing pages. Custom build them with Tailwind glassmorphism.
